title: copy: Task/CalendarEvent/FileNode revalidate copied metadata
description: draft-ietf-jmap-metadata-04 §3.4 (L658-661): 'Copied values are not revalidated against the destination account: data in a copied namespace that is not supported there is handled as described in Section 2.1.1, and maxDepth applies only to values supplied in the create object.' Task/copy (jmap-tasks-server), CalendarEvent/copy (jmap-calendars-server) and FileNode/copy (jmap-filenode-server) merge the create entry into the source and store the result through create_object, whose memory backends run check_metadata_create on every metadata value, copied or supplied. A copied namespace the destination does not support, or a copied value deeper than the destination maxDepth, therefore fails the copy. JMAP-s4kp.9 added the handler-side §3.4 rules (using gate, null rejection, privateMetadata/metadata stripping) but could not tell create_object which values were supplied. Fix: mirror Email/copy and ContactCard/copy, i.e. a backend copy_object(.., create) that validates only the create object's metadata (canonical: jmap-mail-server check_metadata_create(supplied, val)). Discovered in JMAP-s4kp.9.
